meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范制作可拖动定位的关键帧动画,确保动画在时间轴上能被准确控制,并用命令行工具验证关键帧是否合格。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要 seek-safe 的 2D/3D 关键帧、GSAP 时间线或 CSS 动画等,或运行'hyperframes keyframes'诊断时触发。

say.text: 用 GSAP 给这个盒子做一个从左到右的动画,最后停在终点。
say.note: 会生成注册在时间线上的关键帧,可拖动定位。

say.text: 用 CSS 关键帧让这个标题淡入并保持到最后。
say.note: 会设置有限时长和填充模式,保证播放稳定。

say.text: 把这个 SVG 路径做成描边绘制动画。
say.note: 会优先使用 DrawSVGPlugin 或描边虚线实现。

howto.what_en: Claude will create seek-safe keyframe animations following HyperFrames spec, ensuring the animation can be precisely controlled on the timeline, and verify the keyframes with command-line tools.
howto.when_en: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS animations, etc., or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics.

say_en.text: Make a GSAP animation moving this box left to right and stop at the end.
say_en.note: Registers keyframes on the timeline, seek-safe.

say_en.text: Use CSS keyframes to fade in this title and hold it to the end.
say_en.note: Sets finite duration and fill mode for stable playback.

say_en.text: Make this SVG path draw itself with a stroke animation.
